notes: Feeder entries copy the 22 corridors on the metro-status.com dashboard snapshot dated 2026-10-05.
Online/offline status and service frequency are omitted and are not used for recognition.
Substation lists are copied only where the source detail panel provided them.
An unavailable substation list means the source supplied none. Stops were not invented.
Corridor endpoints come from the source titles. Disagreements with stop lists are preserved in source_uncertainty_notes.
FR-04 and FR-4 are separate unresolved entries.
FRG-01 and the Green Line are separate database records. Equivalence has not been verified.
Destination aliases are recognition spellings, not verified new routes.
